policies.physics: Raises raw v28 confidence floor from 0.50 to 0.52 while keeping nonnegative executable edge. Tests whether a tiny probability margin removes noisy boundary rows while keeping broad coverage.
Subtracts estimated Kalshi taker fee from raw v28 probability before entry. This is pure execution physics, not a fitted threshold.
Subtracts fee plus fragile-touch depth penalties. Tests whether thin/crowded touch conditions make raw fair value overconfident.
